Package com.csse3200.game.components.maingame

Class AbilityMenu

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.components.Component
com.csse3200.game.components.maingame.AbilityMenu
public class AbilityMenu extends Component
What the player is choosing between while Hecate's menu is open, and nothing about how it looks.

Keeping the state here rather than in the display means the whole flow can be tested without a GL context: the display only draws what this says, and the menu's input component only calls into it.

It opens on NpcInteractionEvents.INTERACTION_FINISHED rather than on the dialogue starting, so Hecate says her piece first and the menu never shares the screen with a dialogue box. While it is open it holds a control lock of its own, which is separate from the lock the interaction itself took and so outlives it.
